name: Entire
description: Captures coding-agent sessions as checkpoints linked to commits and hosts Git repos with eval-scored Trail reviews, for teams shipping code with agents, via the entire CLI.

skills.name: Session Checkpoints
skills.description: Captures the prompts, transcript, and files touched for each commit with agent work, stored as Git refs beside the code.

skills.name: Trails
skills.description: Follows a change from intent to merge, with findings from review agents that score every push.

skills.name: Distributed Git Hosting
skills.description: Hosts Entire-native repositories or mirrors GitHub ones on clusters in several regions for data residency.

skills.name: Session Search
skills.description: Runs hybrid semantic and keyword search over checkpoints, commits, and sessions.

skills.name: Session Resume
skills.description: Restores a branch's agent sessions so you can continue the work in your agent.
